prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a premium editorial cover for a Hardware Test Engineer in Robotics career guide, landscape 16:9. Visual thesis: test engineers uncover what happens inside a mechanism. A dramatic extreme-close technical cutaway of an invented robotic wrist and precision bearing assembly mounted in a working laboratory load-test fixture. Look into the mechanism at bearing height from a diagonal side angle; the nearest outer housing is selectively cut away so its machined steel bearings and geared internals are visible. One end is clamped to a substantial test stand that recedes into a dark experimental lab, with believable instrument cables and load hardware giving context. Photorealistic materials with a sophisticated conceptual technical-cutaway treatment, hard raking light, high tactile detail, asymmetric frame-filling crop. Roughly 85 percent black, white and gray; restrained vivid violet on a few fixture details and cables occupying 10 to 15 percent. No human, no full robot, no labels, words, logos, numbers, plots, heatmaps, glowing data overlays or paper-like material. No isolated catalog product on a white studio background. This is an invented editorial interpretation, not a proprietary technical design or real test evidence.
